mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tool_call WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM tool_call WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND run_id = #{run} AND resource_id = #{resource} AND status IN ('succeeded','failed','cancelled') AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(result_redacted_json, '$.fileId')) = #{file} ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tool_call (id, enterprise_id, run_id, attempt_id, step_id, actor_user_id, resource_id, resource_kind, resource_version_id, plugin_tool_id, tool_name, operation_id, framework_call_id, framework_session_id, operation_class, argument_hash, request_hash, request_encrypted_json, request_redacted_json, lease_version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{id2}, (SELECT id FROM run_attempt WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND run_id = #{id2} AND attempt_no = #{currentAttemptNo}), #{step}, #{userId}, #{resourceId}, #{resourceKind}, #{resourceVersionId}, #{pluginToolId}, #{value}, #{id}, #{call}, #{session}, #{value2}, #{argumentHash}, #{requestHash}, #{value3}, #{value4}, #{leaseVersion}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE tool_call SET status = 'failed', error_code = 'DATA_QUERY_INTERRUPTED', error_summary = '查询进程已中断，未取得可用结果。', finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, duration_ms = GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, started_at, #{now}) DIV 1000) WHERE run_id IS NULL AND resource_kind = 'data' AND status = 'running' AND started_at < #{before}
